targets.old_statement: Space exits scan the right shoulder first and the left shoulder last, reversing the left-first habit of ordinary lane changes.

targets.statement: When pulling into traffic from a parallel parking space, the six-step scan begins by looking over your right shoulder through the rear window, continues through the interior mirror, signal, and side mirrors, and finishes with left-shoulder checks before entering the lane when safe.
